name: Mimi Stokes
source:
Mimi, the player character, is a new transfer student at Happy Valley High.

An aspiring artist, she dreams of hitting it big with a popular webcomic one day, and hopefully that day is soon!

[From [url=http://www.stardust-soda.com/through-the-panels/]official website[/url]]

Born in 1997.
Hometown: Caldwell, New Jersey.
